senses.definition: A fastening consisting of two metal rings, designed to go around a person's wrists, and connected by a chain or hinge.

quotes.text: It was the sergeant who had spoken to me, and he was now looking round at the company, with his handcuffs invitingly extended towards them in his right hand, and his left on my shoulder.
